description: Pick a color to keep and turn everything else black-and-white — the classic color splash effect with a tolerance slider.

faqs.a: Tolerance controls how close a pixel's color must be to your chosen color to stay colored. Low values keep only near-exact matches; high values keep similar shades too.
faqs.q: What does the tolerance slider do?

faqs.a: Click the color box, then use the eyedropper (in Chrome/Edge) to sample a color straight from your photo for a perfect match.
faqs.q: How do I pick the exact color from my photo?

faqs.a: Yes — the effect runs on your photo's pixels in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Pick the color you want to keep (use the eyedropper to sample it from the photo).
Drag the tolerance slider until only your subject stays colored.
Click "Download image" to save the PNG.
title: Color Splash Effect
